summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K disclosing share repurchases under the Second Tranche of its existing buyback program, reporting transactions executed between 26 October and 2 November 2026 through J.P.Morgan SE as Second Tranche manager. Cumulative cash deployed on the Second Tranche reached roughly €239.7 million, about 23.97% of the tranche's maximum cash amount. The disclosure is a routine MAR Article 5 transaction report, not a new program authorization or tender offer; no price per share, premium or closing date is stated. Watch pace of remaining tranche execution and any cancellation of repurchased shares.
